title: Adjunction for the realized common-stage compact-support action
statement: Let l be prime and D be a finite-field datum, with l different from D.p. Let f : X → Y be a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type D.k-schemes, with no absolute separatedness assumption, and fix a compactification c of f. Let P be a normalized CoefficientConstruction at the auxiliary algebraic closure ULift(PadicAlgCl l), and let S be any StageAction l D hl P c of the locally finite adic compact-support realization [lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-compact-support-realization]. Thus its finite left functors and scalar comparisons are the rational functors and q-comparisons in P [lem-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-construction]. Then the actual S.system.functor on the unlifted common-stage categories is a left adjoint.

source.place: Common finite-field passage and final exceptional-adjunction sentence; rational coefficient adjunction descent

proof.text: At each unlifted finite coefficient stage take the right functor and adjunction of P.ring.operation c (.rational (finiteField l E)). Transport its left functor along S.finite. Identify each stage-system transition with the published rational scalar functor using stageSystem_existsUnique, and transport the invertible b of P.fields.rationalComparison along those transition equalities. The defining counit equation and S.scalar give the counit square for S.system.beta.

source.place: Common finite-field passage and final exceptional-adjunction sentence; rational coefficient adjunction descent

proof.text: Prove the right stage coherence directly from S.system.coh and these counit squares: transpose both proposed composites under the final finite adjunction, precompose with the two invertible left comparisons, use their naturality and the two counit squares, and finish with naturality of the stage associator and S.system.coh. This constructs a coherent right stage morphism without separately invoking coefficient_construction_coherence. Transposing the counit square and using the adjunction triangles gives the unit square. Thus the finite units and counits give compatible Hom records for the identity and composite stage morphisms.

source.place: Common finite-field passage and final exceptional-adjunction sentence; rational coefficient adjunction descent

proof.text: Apply StageSystem.Morphism.adjunction to the right stage morphism, finite adjunctions, and compatible unit and counit records. Extract its IsLeftAdjoint property. The descent retains the original unlifted finite coefficient categories, includes repeated stages, and applies unchanged to zero objects and empty schemes.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupport_stageAction_isLeftAdjoint
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    {f : X ⟶ Y} [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (P : ConstructibleExceptionalCoefficients.CoefficientConstruction l
      (ULift.{u} (PadicAlgCl l)) D hl (f := f)) (c : Compactification f)
    (S : StageAction l D hl P c) : S.system.functor.IsLeftAdjoint
